scope: Corpus self-maintenance: classify_content_type() deterministic keyword classifier, ingest() auto-typing when content_type=NULL, reclassify_corpus() batch backfill, consolidate() near-duplicate collapsing via union-find. All functions DRY-RUN by default. No schema changes, no GUC additions, no ranking algorithm changes.
justification: Feature gate only — no learning-algorithm change, no confidence model change, no recall ranking change. Functional correctness verified by pg_regress 47/47 (test_v0140_classify, consolidate). consolidate() guards verified: never self-supersede, never cross-role collapse. reclassify_corpus dry-run verified: no writes emitted when p_dry_run=TRUE. ingest auto-classify verified: existing callers with explicit content_type unaffected. No statistical pre-registration required for pure housekeeping functions.
schema_change_detail: None — additive function overloads only. ingest() content_type parameter was already present; auto-classify is a NULL-input behaviour change only.
scoring_impact: none — no change to recall ranking, confidence, or reinforce() paths
recall_ranking_impact: none — consolidate() and reclassify_corpus() are housekeeping functions; they do not modify the recall query plan
backward_compat_proof: pg_regress consolidate + test_v0140_classify verify backward-compat. All existing callers passing explicit content_type to ingest() are unaffected (function signature additive with DEFAULT NULL). Upgrade path is incremental (0.13.0→0.14.0) or fresh-install.

corpus.note: functional gate only; no statistical validation required for housekeeping functions
